headline: Crystal Crop Protection Shares List at 3% Premium on Bombay Stock Exchange
summary: Crystal Crop Protection shares opened at ₹280 on the BSE and ₹278 on the NSE, marking a 3% premium over their initial public offering price.
why: Initial public offering listing premiums indicate immediate secondary market demand and investor appetite for newly floated corporate equities.

impacts.name: Crystal Crop Protection
impacts.why: A positive listing premium reflects favorable secondary market valuation relative to the IPO price.
